detail.longDescription: "Fibromyalgia or chronic pain affects millions of people, yet it remains one of the most misunderstood chronic illnesses. If you've been told your symptoms are "just stress," "all in your head," or that you simply need more sleep, this explains what fibromyalgia really is, why it develops, and what modern science has discovered about the biological changes occurring in the nervous system, immune system, and brain. You'll learn about: - Common fibromyalgia symptoms, including widespread pain, fatigue, poor sleep, and brain fog - Central sensitization and why the nervous system becomes hypersensitive to pain - The possible roles of neuroinflammation, immune dysfunction, and small fiber neuropathy - How sleep disruption may contribute to chronic pain and fatigue - The connection between fibromyalgia, ME/CFS, Long COVID, POTS, and other chronic illnesses - Conventional treatment options and emerging integrative approaches - Why fibromyalgia is now recognized as a real, biological condition For decades, people living with fibromyalgia have struggled to be believed. Today, growing research is helping us better understand the complex mechanisms behind this condition and providing new reasons for hope."—Dr. Gary Kaplan Fibromyalgia: What It is, Why It Happens & Why The Pain Is Real > https:// youtu.be/qZqb0OdFfq8?si=27m2_x q7bB0sOGdA # fibromyalgia # research # medical_science # chronic_disease # biological_changes # irritable_bowel # misunderstood_illness # brain_gut_axis # central_sensitization # fatigue # pain # brain_fog # nervous_system # POTS # ME_CFS # PTSD # sleep_disruption # hypervigilance # long_covid # neuro_inflammatory_disease # small_fiber_neuropathy # chronic_pain # immune_dysfunction # not_just_stress # biological_condition # medicine # health # video
